privacy: Files stay on your device. No uploads or remote resources.
drop: Drop an ODT or OTT file here
formats: Read an OpenDocument text file or template in your browser.
invalid: This document is damaged or incomplete. Try saving a new ODT copy in your office application.
emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose an ODT or OTT document with content.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this document. Close other tabs and try again.
protected: This document is encrypted or password protected. Save an unencrypted copy in your office application first.
unsupported: This is not a supported OpenDocument text file. Choose an ODT or OTT file; spreadsheets and presentations are not supported here.
noContent: This document has no readable content. It may be blank or contain only unsupported objects.
reflow: Continuous reading layout. Fonts, spacing, and page layout may differ from your office application.
changes: Tracked changes appear as if accepted: added text is shown and deleted text is hidden. The original file is unchanged.
limited: Some content cannot be displayed fully. Linked or missing images, complex drawings, embedded objects, and comments may be omitted.
safePreview: External links, remote resources, macros, and active content are disabled. Internal references remain available.
pagePartsHelp: Available default and first-page headers and footers are shown separately. They do not repeat as printed pages.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the preview.
